subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw expose plugin Control UI entry points as a public SDK/Gateway API, and if so must plugin pages be restricted to opaque sandboxed in-app frames before this branch can merge?
rationale: This PR changes a public plugin API and a browser security boundary, so code review can identify the unsafe paths but cannot choose the permanent plugin UI trust model alone.

options.title: Require sandbox-only launch contract
options.body: Merge only after same-window/new-window routes are removed or moved to a separate-origin model, plugin iframes use a fixed opaque sandbox, launch failures fail closed, and current-head proof is refreshed.

options.title: Approve broader launch surface
options.body: Maintain the same-window/new-window API only if maintainers explicitly accept same-origin plugin page risk and document the threat model and operator controls.

options.title: Pause for RFC alignment
options.body: Hold or close this branch until the broader Control UI plugin contribution RFC settles the supported UI contribution model.

recommendation.title: Require sandbox-only launch contract
recommendation.body: Merge only after same-window/new-window routes are removed or moved to a separate-origin model, plugin iframes use a fixed opaque sandbox, launch failures fail closed, and current-head proof is refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the closest RFC and merged host-hook foundation history for this plugin UI contribution surface.
